title: Queue items name what blocks them: a dependency tree
what: An optional field blocked_by on a queue item: the slugs whose result this item needs (its name is the item file's name without .json). The model writes it when it adds the item (`blocked_by` in the add TOML) and later with `relay queue block <slug> --by <slug>` when a dependency is found after the item was added. Code checks facts only: each slug exists (open items or done/), no cycle; otherwise the write is refused and nothing changes. Whether an item is blocked is computed when reading (a blocker not yet in done/), never stored. `relay queue` marks blocked items with their open blockers; `relay queue tree` shows the tree; `relay queue take` refuses a blocked item, naming the blocker; a dropped blocker is shown as "blocker dropped: reconsider". The field is optional: the existing item files stay valid unchanged; the known links are then set with `block`. Not in this item: choosing which unblocked items start together (the scheduler, its own item).
why: Owner's proposal, 24 Oct: "blocked_by - поле которое поддерживается моделью, обычно на момент создания изменения мы можем заранее сказать чем оно блокируется"; "под блокер я имел ввиду мой proposal касательно изменений blocked_by и внедрения древа зависимостей в нашу очередь". Today dependencies live in prose and in the front's head, and were lost at a compaction. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: openspec-tools-live-in-the-core-plugin needs spec-writing-leaves-the-main-pipeline-sdd-become merged first, but nothing in the queue says so: `relay queue take openspec-tools-live-in-the-core-plugin` succeeds while the OpenSpec item is still open.
pass_cases: With blocked_by = ["spec-writing-leaves-the-main-pipeline-sdd-become"], take of openspec-tools-live-in-the-core-plugin is refused naming the blocker; after the blocker is in done/ the take succeeds.
add or block with an unknown slug, or one that makes a cycle, is refused and writes nothing.

relay queue tree shows the three links spec-writing-leaves-the-main-pipeline-sdd-become -> openspec-tools-live-in-the-core-plugin, the-change-cycle-builds-independent-groups-in-pa, a-spec-fix-is-marked-met-by-reading-not-by-runni.
every existing item file passes relay queue check without being rewritten.
where: lib/relay_queue.py (schema, parse, add, take, a block command; lib copies)
